[UC]​, dermatitis herpetiformis​ [Celiac]​), rashes, and erythematous, swollen joints.
Pruritic papulovesicles on extensors + granular IgA at dermal papillary tips = dermatitis herpetiformis, strongly associated with celiac disease (gluten sensitivity)
